requiredFindings.title: INIT after an uncertain outcome writes no witness
requiredFindings.failureScenario: reconcile_after_uncertain returns Initialize for an empty journal with no witness and leaves the witness absent. Item 4's reconciliation writes the witness on REVERT, ADVANCE, and INIT. Item 5 and X3d r3 item 7 step 1 run that reconciliation in this writer while the lease is held. The carrier start already writes COMMITTED 0 for the same proposal. Required: on Initialize, write the witness COMMITTED at generation 1, sequence 0, bodySha256 null, by that file protocol, and still return Initialize so the floor copy stays off. QUARANTINE and a failed reconciliation still write nothing and leave the floor untouched.

scope: X3b-1b r1. RF-1: an INIT outcome after an uncertain journal result must write the COMMITTED 0 witness and still return a non-copyable outcome. Tail confirmation before the witness write, TailChanged as LedgerCorrupt, uncertainTailLoss for a Certain end with no carrier, caller-held fence and lease, no crate re-export, and the deferred carrier_floor.rs sentence are accepted. Inventory v92 ACCEPT on parent v91. Replay: carrier_floor 30 passed, 642 filtered out. Workspace suite, clippy, fmt, check_package_edges, and verify_scratch were not replayed.
